note: City of Bertram, TX. INSTRUMENT: Zoning Ordinance (Exhibit 14A) § 20(j) Chart 1 (yards/height/lot area), § 20(k) Chart 2 (lot coverage) and Chart 3 (F.A.R.); current through Ord. No. 215-081126 (2026-08-11). SOURCE: ecode360.com, pack C (2026-10-07), cross-matched against the register (LDT #800). SCOPE: 19 of Bertram's 21 districts. R-1-A stays UNROWED (SETBACK_CONDITIONAL_NOT_EVALUATED: its side-yard cell states a misleadingly simple 5 ft in Chart 1 but a footnote states the real zero-lot-line rule separately -- the register refuses rather than serve either number alone). H (Historic Overlay) ALSO stays UNROWED as of the 2026-10-09 W3 PR #805 review: every one of its Chart-1 cells is the same bare footnote reference to "whichever base-use district governs the proposed use" -- unlike CBD and PUD below, H has no cell this footnote does not cover, so there is no base case left to code, and it is now SETBACK_NO_DIMENSIONAL_STANDARDS in the register (the same code Meadowlakes' districts carry) rather than verified-browser-read. READING RULES: (1) Chart 2's "X% main building(s); Y% main and all accessory" pattern (R-4-1/2/3, C, C-1, CBD, O, LI, HI) is a MAIN-vs-MAIN-PLUS-ACCESSORY split of the SAME building-coverage metric, not a buildings-vs-impervious split (no impervious figure is stated anywhere in this chapter) -- the base case coded is the lower, main-building-only figure, and the higher main-plus-accessory total is the quoted condition; max_impervious_pct is not_specified throughout this city for the same reason. (2) R-4-1/2/3's height footnotes (6)/(7)/(8) state a STORY cap ("not to exceed one/two/three stories") alongside the stated feet figure, not a competing number -- the feet figure is coded and the story cap is quoted. (3) CBD and PUD carry Chart-1 cells that are bare footnote references -- (9) or (10) -- reading "see the base-use district" or "see Section 40", NOT numbers; a correct reader that dropped the parenthesis and read "10" or "9" as feet would silently invent a setback the ordinance never states for that cell. front_ft/side_ft/rear_ft (and, for CBD, side_corner_ft and max_height_ft too) are therefore not_specified for these two districts, with the deferral footnote quoted verbatim. PUD's own corner yard (15 ft) and height (45 ft) ARE stated directly in Chart 1 and are coded normally -- the distinguishing fact from H is that PUD and CBD each have AT LEAST ONE cell the footnote does not cover (PUD's corner/height; CBD's own lot-coverage split), so a real base case survives for them. SENTINELS: not_specified = 100, except max_height_ft's canonical 999 (used for CBD only). No code-section atom corpus exists yet for bertram_tx; every value is primary-source-verified.
